profile.name: Naufal Arkan Wahib
profile.headline: AI-nspirator & Public Speaker
about: I build intelligent systems that turn research, data, and emerging technologies into practical solutions for real-world problems.
My work is driven by curiosity and execution: exploring ideas, building intelligent systems, testing them rigorously, and turning promising concepts into real-world solutions.

research.narrative: I am interested in building intelligent systems that can understand complex data, reason across multiple modalities, evaluate their outputs, and support real-world decisions while remaining transparent, reliable, and under meaningful human oversight.

focus.name: Big Data
focus.description: Large-scale data processing, analytics, and intelligent pipelines for extracting reliable insights from complex, high-volume data.

focus.name: Applied AI
focus.description: Practical AI solutions that transform data and models into reliable, usable systems for real-world problems.

focus.name: Vibe Coding
focus.description: AI-assisted software development focused on rapid prototyping, iterative building, and turning ideas into working products.

focus.name: Multimodal
focus.description: Integration and reasoning across text, audio, images, and sensor data to build richer and more context-aware AI systems.
